newsitem.headline: TABLE-Reliastar Financial Corp Q2 oper net.

text.p: Avg. Common And Common Equivalent Shares
Avg. Common Shares Assuming Maximum Dilution

(a) Premium revenues are determined in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles. Premium revenues are larger when presented on a statutory basis than when presented in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.

(b) Operating income and net realized investment gains and losses are not presented on the statement of income; however, they are shown here for analysis purposes. Operating income excludes realized investment gains and losses and their impact on the amortization of deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits. Prior period information has been restated to reflect this definition of operating income.
